subject: update phase1 landed 68de3b2
body:
phase1 landed 68de3b2 (claude/naadi-shared). Authors can start.

What authors need
- Guide: docs/CONTENT_AUTHORING.md (pack layout, JSON for sections, items, sequential and abstract sets, cards and figures, tag fields, commands).
- Packs (one per task, each pre-created with an empty skeleton):

  | Task | Pack | Prefix |
  |---|---|---|
  | S23-A | data/content/general-immune-blood | s23a |
  | S23-B | data/content/cardio-resp | s23b |
  | S23-C | data/content/renal-endo-nutrition | s23c |
  | S23-D | data/content/gi-multisystem | s23d |
  | S23-E | data/content/neuro-behavioral | s23e |
  | S23-F | data/content/skin-msk-repro | s23f |
  | S23-G | data/content/biostat-social | s23g |

  Every id must start with `<prefix>-`.
- Worked example: apps/api/tests/fixtures/content/sample-pack. It has a section with a figure, a single item, an abstract set, a sequential set and 2 cards.
- Commands:
  - `pnpm --filter @naadi/shared seed:convert` (section bodies);
  - `cd apps/api && uv run python ../../tools/validate_content.py --pack <pack> [--areas]` (`--areas` shows targets vs counts per leaf);
  - `uv run python scripts/seed.py --data ../../data` (local stack only).
- Legacy items: authors leave data/*.json alone. To fix a legacy item's area, use `retag` in their own pack.json; to replace a legacy item, use `retire`.

Taxonomy and blueprint
- USMLE-2026 has 18 systems, 147 categories and 276 areas. Leaves are the 276 areas plus 15.06 and 15.07, which have no areas, so 278 leaves.
- Axes: disc (11), cs (5), task (13).
- Ids look like usmle2026.08.05.01. The generator is tools/usmle2026.py; its --check runs in CI.
- Blueprint: 278 leaves × 2 Steps, min 6 per area, about 2,151 Step 1 and 2,242 Step 2 CK targets including the min-6 floor. Stored in blueprint_targets.
- All 685 legacy items are mapped to areas: crosswalk plus keyword scoring, best effort, fixable by retag.

Migration 0039 (0038 went to seg18): taxonomy_nodes columns, blueprint_targets, taxonomy_crosswalk, content_packs, question_sets, and the new questions columns. why_not and the others are not granted to clients. RLS is in the same migration. Single head.

Local evidence (own stack, pg-seg23 / st-seg23 / auth-seg23)
- Unit pytest: 1773 passed, 1 skipped.
- db, full suite on a fresh stack: 682 passed. The 18 failures were embeddings/ingest tests with no model cache. After prefetch, those modules passed (17 passed); test_perf is not counted.
- New tests: test_seed_packs (import, idempotent second run with 0 changes, leak and RLS checks) and tests/seed/test_packs.py (13 authoring-mistake cases).
- vitest: 739 web, 134 shared, 75 ink, 33 ui.
- lint, typecheck (tsc per package, mypy), gen:contracts: no drift.

Next: phase 2 (validators, sources.yaml, form assembler + exam mode, coverage page + tools/coverage.py, official-practice page, card generation).
